name: – Lara Wolters – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: REPORT on a draft regulation of the European Parliament amending Decision 2005/684/EC, Euratom adopting the Statute for Members of the European Parliament, as regards proxy voting
part_text:
Members of the European Parliament who are pregnant or have just given birth would be allowed to have another Member cast their vote for them in the full Parliament. This would cover up to three months before the expected birth and six months after. The report asks for the rules for Members to be changed to allow this. It also sets conditions: the arrangement is voluntary, can be cancelled, and must be recorded publicly.

- **What changes:** A pregnant or new mother can let another Member vote for her in the full Parliament.
- **Who it affects:** Members of the European Parliament who are pregnant or have recently given birth.
- **What happens next:** Member States must approve the related change to the election rules before this can start.
